Search PubMed from database inception through 2024-12-31 without geographic restriction. Screen peer-reviewed English-language records and records with sufficient English abstracts or metadata; use reviews for terminology and landmark discovery while grounding substantive claims in primary studies. Decision-relevant outcomes are genetic association and segregation, penetrance, ancestry dependence, enzymatic activity, substrate phosphorylation at endogenous abundance, pathway consequences, neurodegeneration phenotypes, and evidence of inconsistency or dissociation among these outcomes.
